n: Stanford Digital Education high school AI curriculum
t: High school lesson plans from Stanford that pair with Google's AI Essentials course.
steps: Search for Stanford Digital Education and its AI curriculum page.
Find the contact route. The materials do not give one.
Ask whether the lesson plans are open to your school.
Ask whether licenses for the Google course are needed.
Ask IT to review Google accounts and student data rules.
Plan a schedule of about 10 weeks.
